title.en: DeepSeek publishes dsh-superagent research prototype code
title.zhHans: DeepSeek 公开 dsh-superagent 研究原型代码

searchSummary.en: DeepSeek’s public repository records October 31 creation and explicitly labels dsh-superagent research code, not a production product.
searchSummary.zhHans: DeepSeek 的公开仓库记录 10 月 31 日创建，并明确将 dsh-superagent 标为研究代码而非生产产品。

summary.en: A repository under DeepSeek’s GitHub organization records creation on October 31 and makes dsh-superagent prototype code and an MIT license available. Its README describes an agent for a single GitHub repository, built around DeepSeek Harness, and explicitly says it is research code, not an official DeepSeek product or production-ready software. Repository creation does not establish the minute it first became publicly downloadable or adoption by others.
summary.zhHans: DeepSeek 的 GitHub 组织下，一个记录创建于 10 月 31 日的公开仓库提供 dsh-superagent 原型代码和 MIT 许可。README 将其描述为面向单一 GitHub 仓库、围绕 DeepSeek Harness 构建的智能体，并明确说明这是研究代码，并非 DeepSeek 正式产品或可投入生产的软件。仓库创建时间不能确定其首次供公众下载的时刻，也不能证明外部采用。

narrative.en: The event is code availability for an experimental tool, not a production agent deployment or independently measured autonomy gain. The repository’s own warning about differences from its internal version limits any attempt to infer internal operational performance.
narrative.zhHans: 事件记录实验工具代码可获取，不代表生产环境部署或自主能力已获独立量化验证。仓库还提醒公开版与内部版本不完全相同，因此不能据此推断内部运行表现。

text.en: The public deepseek-ai repository was created October 31, 2026, and contains a dsh-superagent research prototype for one GitHub repository.
text.zhHans: deepseek-ai 的公开仓库创建于 2026 年 10 月 31 日，包含面向单一 GitHub 仓库的 dsh-superagent 研究原型。

text.en: The README says this is a reference-only research prototype, not an official or production-ready DeepSeek product.
text.zhHans: README 称该代码仅供研究参考，既非 DeepSeek 正式产品，也未达到生产可用状态。
